entities.name: Salvador Abascal Infante
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Salvador Abascal Infante was a Mexican politician and leading exponent of Mexican synarchism. For a time, he was the leader of the National Synarchist Union (UNS). Abascal represented the orthodox Catholic tendency within the movement.
